scope: Numerical comparison with a source-based legacy reconstruction; not in-game measurements or post-update renderer validation.
notes: Every player preset is tested at every height: these are controlled test resolutions, not claims of each player's actual video settings.
hauptrolle_preview uses fixed display coordinates, not resolution-aware engine pixels. Its cross-resolution mismatch count is diagnostic only.
Gap is excluded from dimension counters: hauptrolle uses cl_fixedcrosshairgap rather than cl_crosshairgap, so a direct gap comparison would be misleading.
No best-fit parameters are estimated from actual post-update observations: none were available in this experiment.
